mechanics.claim: Mystic Shot applies on-hit and on-attack effects.
On hit, all of Ezreal's abilities have their current cooldowns reduced by 1.5 seconds, including Mystic Shot's own cooldown.
mechanics.quote: the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Ezreal's''' abilities, including ''Mystic Shot's'', are reduced by {{fd|1.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Mystic Shot deals basic damage but is also tagged as spell damage, so it triggers spell effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Mystic Shot'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}

mechanics.claim: Even if blocked by a spell shield, the cooldown reduction still triggers.
mechanics.quote: Even if the ability is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}} it will still trigger the cooldown reduction.

mechanics.claim: Mystic Shot benefits from life steal, omnivamp, and physical vamp, but not spell vamp.
mechanics.quote: ''Mystic Shot'' benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, {{tip|omnivamp}}, and {{tip|physical vamp}}, but not {{tip|spell vamp}}
